subject: FW: New MFA Enforcement – Service Accounts (Policy SEC-2025-014)
body_text:
Hi dev team,

From 2025-08-15, all service accounts used in CI/CD, IaC, and deployment pipelines MUST have MFA enforced (including machine-to-machine tokens). Technical implementation is a two-factor check at the API gateway layer.

Expected pipeline manifest (Terraform):

  resource "service_account_policy" "ci_deploy" {
    name           = "svc_ci_deploy"
    mfa_required   = true
    mfa_provider   = "fido2-vault"
    token_ttl_sec  = 259200   # 72 hours max
    rotation_days  = 7
  }

Timeline:
  - July 1: warnings only
  - Aug 15: hard enforcement (401 on missing MFA token)
  - Sep 1: legacy token endpoints decommissioned

Migration guide: https://wiki.enterprise.local/eng/mfa-service-accounts

Do not post token values or credential material in tickets or chat.

Thanks,
IT Security Engineering
enterprise.local

subject: RE: Data Retention Policy v3.2 – Implementation Timeline & Config Changes
body_text:
Hi team,

Legal has finalized Data Retention Policy v3.2 (DRP-3.2). Effective 2025-10-01, migration window 6 weeks.

New classification-to-retention mapping for retention-config repo:

  retention_policy:
    version: "3.2"
    scope: "prod-pipelines"
    classes:
      - name: customer_pii
        retain_days: 365
        then_action: pseudonymize
      - name: transactional_logs
        retain_days: 180
        then_action: archive_cold
      - name: debug_traces
        retain_days: 30
        then_action: purge

Note: "then_action" replaces the old "lifecycle_end" key. Pipelines using the old key will fail validation.

Open question: does ANL-BATCH-4471 fall under transactional_logs or customer_pii? Need answer by July 20.

Thanks,
Priya Raman
Legal & Regulatory Affairs
